text:
Sara Nguyen: Heads up — customer (acme-inc) hitting a ton of 5xx on hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. Reports: ~30% error rate, high p99 latency. They included a curl and a few sample logs.
Jamal Ortiz: thanks, digging in. can you paste the curl + error body?
Sara Nguyen: paste below: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-x' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b", "input":"hello"}' \ 

Response:
{"error":{"message":"gateway error: upstream 502","code":502}}
```
Sara Nguyen: Also seeing in their app logs repeated `controlplane: error fetching routing policy: 500` messages.
Jamal Ortiz: ok i pulled control-plane logs around that time. seeing repeated timeouts to configdb and routing-policy svc. snippet: 
```
2024-06-28T09:11:52Z controlplane routing: ERROR fetchPolicy timeout (configdb) id=acme-inc err="context deadline exceeded"
2024-06-28T09:12:01Z routing-policy: WARN upstream call failed status=502 target=configdb
2024-06-28T09:12:05Z auth: ERROR session lookup error status=500 store=redis timeout
```
Jamal Ortiz: metrics show configdb latency spike and connection queueing around 09:10-09:14 UTC. configdb pods had a GC pause? not sure yet.
Kevin Li: i'm on call, let me check k8s and DB metrics. Kevin Li: running `kubectl get pods -n infra configdb -o wide` now.
infra-bot: deploybot: configdb autoscaler triggered 2->5 pods at 09:11:30 UTC due to cpu spike.
Kevin Li: configdb pods show high iowait on node ip-10-2-7-14, mounting slow disk. kernel logs show blk_iocost throttling.
Maria Patel: customer impact severity? billing or loss of requests?
Sara Nguyen: customer reports failed requests and some timeouts causing degraded UX. not billing break, but high error volume for their production workload.
Jamal Ortiz: immediate mitigation options: 1) route requests to older cached routing-policy snapshot (fallback), 2) scale configdb to warm nodes, 3) restart routing-policy pods to clear stuck connections. prefer 1+3 as quick wins.
Kevin Li: I'll restart routing-policy pods and cordon the bad node for configdb to stop scheduling until we triage disk. doing `kubectl rollout restart deploy/routing-policy -n controlplane` now.
Kevin Li: restarted, monitoring logs.
Sara Nguyen: i've told acme-inc we're investigating and applied an emergency fallback to serve default routing policy for their org id to avoid further policy lookups. customer confirmed retries now get 200s for a bit. :slightly_smiling_face:
Jamal Ortiz: logs after restart show routing-policy errors drop significantly, but configdb still flakey — still seeing occasional timeouts. need root cause for storage layer.
Kevin Li: cordoned node, cordon done. I'll request infra to move replicas off that disk. raised infra ticket INF-4231.
oncall-bot: incident created INC-2024-0628-controlplane-deps-5xx, severity=P2, owners=@oncall @infra @sre
Maria Patel: can we add a short-run mitigation doc in the customer's ticket so CS can reconcile? Also need to enable longer cache TTL for routing-policy for next 24h.
Sara Nguyen: done — added notes and TTL bump to 600s for their org.
Jamal Ortiz: postmortem action items I propose: - audit configdb disk health and replace hardware if needed - add health check that marks configdb unhealthy earlier to prevent cascading 5xx - implement cached fallback for routing-policy at edge layer - improve autoscaler cooldown to avoid oscillation
Kevin Li: agree. also need a runbook tweak: when configdb timeouts spike, automatically flip routing-policy to fallback mode for orgs with error > 5% for 3 min.
Maria Patel: will create a PR for the runbook and schedule infra postmortem. assigning tasks: Kevin owns infra ticket, Jamal owns routing-policy fallback design, Sara will handle customer comms & closure.
Sara Nguyen: quick note for repro: to reproduce we used a configdb load test that saturated IO. commands: 
```
# basic repro (internal test cluster)
ab -n 10000 -c 200 -p tiny_payload.json -T 'application/json' \ 
http://controlplane-internal:8080/v1/policy?org=acme-inc
```
Sara Nguyen: test generated 502s on hosted gateway at peak load.
Kevin Li: monitoring shows p95 token latency for hosted-api dropped back to normal after restart + fallback. keeping an eye for 30m.
infra-bot: alert resolved for routing-policy errors at 09:18 UTC.
Jamal Ortiz: thanks everyone. i'll start drafting the incident summary and include the logs, timeline, configdb iostat, and the mitigation steps.
Sara Nguyen: customer updated: "we're seeing much fewer errors, thank you" — asking for postmortem when available.
Maria Patel: copying into the incident channel and creating tasks in our backlog: BACKLOG-768 (runbook), BACKLOG-769 (edge cached fallback), BACKLOG-770 (hardware replacement).
Kevin Li: closing out the emergency triage here. will follow up in INC-2024-0628 and link postmortem once ready.
oncall-bot: thread archived to incident INC-2024-0628."
